phrases.greeting: Hello! I will help you fill the scholarship application. I will ask you a few details. Say "stop" any time to stop.
phrases.reply_done: I have filled in the application details and reached the review page.
phrases.reply_handoff: Sorry, I need your help to continue.
phrases.reply_failed: Sorry, I could not finish the task. I need help.
phrases.reply_empty: Sorry, I did not hear that. Please say it again.
phrases.reply_clarify: Right now I can help with the scholarship application. Say "start the scholarship application".
phrases.ask_spelling: Please spell it letter by letter.
phrases.hint_date: Please say the day, month and year.
phrases.hint_email: For example: sita at gmail dot com.
phrases.readback_name_phone: Your name is {name}, phone number {phone}. Is that correct?
phrases.readback_rejected: Okay, stopping. Please correct the details and try again.
phrases.which_field: What should I change? Name or phone number?
